prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE practical game-VFX storyboard based on the supplied real Karen Slay the Spire 2 screenshot. This is an illustrative preview, NOT actual gameplay.
User specifically requests a NEW effect SURROUNDING the ENERGY ICON, and a clear PLAY-CARD ANIMATION that CREATES this persistent surround. Earlier tiny spotlights and edge-outline variants are rejected. Do not reuse beams, chest marks or a recolored hexagon outline.
Design: a delicate floating circular/very slightly elliptical ring of warm theatre light, separate from the existing red faceted energy icon by a clear small gap. At native 1280x720 scale, the icon is about 80 pixels across; new ring is about 98-104 pixels across. Keep the original red icon and cream energy numerals fully unchanged, in front of the new light. Ring belongs to the UI, not the ground. Thin irregular soft light, two tiny comet-like light seeds with short fading tails, a few tiny motes; NO ornamental metal, runes, ticks, progress segments, sci-fi HUD, giant star or solid platform. No rays pointing upward. Maintain the hand-painted anime game VFX language and restrained intensity.
Layout: one landscape 3-column x 2-row storyboard with equal close-up scale for the five local energy-counter panels. Sixth panel is the full battlefield context at near-native composition showing the modest surround at its actual small size in the lower-left UI, away from Karen and her tower. Simple dark caption bands outside the game crops. NO decorative presentation frame.
Top row explains actual creation, all numerals remain 8/3:
1 exact label "打出 · 光粒抵达" : two small golden light seeds approach from left and right and stop on opposite sides of the outside circle. No pre-existing complete ring.
2 exact label "成形 · 绕行留光" : both seeds travel clockwise around their respective half-circles, leaving two partially traced curved light trails outside the icon. Show unmistakably incomplete arcs with active heads; not a whole ring fading in.
3 exact label "完成 · 环绕建立" : the two half-paths meet, creating one slender full surround with tiny brighter heads and sparse settling glints. Not an explosion. This creation takes about one second of presentation time.
Bottom:
4 exact label "有牌 · 双光巡游" : stable quiet warm-gold fine ring, two tiny opposite orbiting heads and short tails, energy still 8/3. Light rim clearly detached from red counter, not just its original border.
5 exact label "空堆 · 单光待续" : after real +1 energy gain, counter reads 9/3. Same surrounding motif, very slightly wider, lower-brightness cool-pearl light, one orbiting head. Resting state, no repeated gain animation.
6 exact label "实机比例参考" : full battle layout inspired by supplied screenshot. Native character, tower, cards, draw/discard icons and all other UI retained. New ring only around native lower-left energy counter, no chest slit, glowing belly, permanent character aura or world-scale light. Do not enlarge the counter or change its position to make it more dramatic.
Footer exact "设计预览 · 非实机".
Constraints: foreground digits always readable; creation itself does not grant energy or change numerals; actual energy gain would briefly draw a few particles from the ring into the icon's rim, not run a line across the battlefield. Nothing overlaps draw pile or hand. No large spark-star, no base, no tower changes. This is a continuous moving surround with an authored formation animation, not a static border color toggle.
